visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a large, industrial-style warehouse with a corrugated metal ceiling. A male with light brown hair and glasses, wearing a black t-shirt and grey tactical pants, stands on a balcony-like walkway. He holds a clear mesh bag containing multiple car keys and smiles at the camera with high energy. (2) The scene shifts to the ground floor of the warehouse, which serves as a car showroom. The male stands in front of a white Mercedes-Benz CLA. He gestures toward the car, pointing out the front grille and logo. He then opens the door to show the black suede interior with red stitching. (3) He moves to a black Mercedes-Benz CLA. He showcases the exterior and then opens the trunk, revealing a complex air suspension system with a large silver tank and black compressor units. He points at the components with his right hand while holding the mesh bag in his left. (4) The male transitions to a black Mercedes-Benz E300. He focuses on the interior dashboard, specifically the dual widescreen displays and ambient lighting. He sits in the driver's seat and gestures toward the screens. (5) The camera pans across a row of white and blue Ford cars. The male introduces a white Ford Focus Wagon, highlighting its cargo space and high-end B&O speakers inside the door panel. (6) He moves between several Ford Focus variants, including a white ST-line and a blue 4.5 generation model. He points out the different wheel designs and interior patterns. (7) Finally, he stands next to a black Toyota Alphard. He slides the side door open and sits in the luxurious rear captain's chairs, leaning back to demonstrate the comfort and space. The lighting is consistent throughout—bright artificial indoor light mixed with some natural light from the open warehouse door.
